title: OGE receives Trump transaction disclosure listing July SpaceX trades
description_medium: The Office of Government Ethics marked a Trump periodic transaction report as received September 14. It lists a July 10 SpaceX share purchase worth $15,001–$50,000 and a July 17 sale worth $1,001–$15,000. The fresh event is the disclosure's receipt, not the earlier trades.
